name: 8 Coil Shakti: Altered States (frontal, then temporal), 40 min
origin: Todd Murphy (8 Coil Shakti software); signal templates licensed from Persinger & Koren
summary: Todd Murphy's 'Altered States' session for the 8 Coil Shakti: the amygdala and hippocampus signals in sequence over both frontal lobes for 20 min, then the same signals over both temporal lobes for 20 min. The vendor says the effects and after-effects should match 'temporal lobe phenomena, including altered states of consciousness'. His meditation page also names it as a session to do before meditation.
notes: The vendor's session 'applies the Amygdala & Hippocampus Signals in Sequence (Left Channel only) signal to The frontal lobes, followed by the same signals (Right Channel only) to the temporal lobes' (output_altered_states.htm). The page's header swaps the channels; both put the frontal lobes first. It gives no phase lengths for its 40-min and 60-min runs: 20 + 20 min is inferred (30 + 30: murphy-shakti8-altered-states-60min). Phase 1 drives the four frontal coils (Fp1, AF3, Fp2, AF4), phase 2 the four temporal coils (FT7, TP7, FT8, TP8). Sites and polarity are this project's reading of vendor photos: AF3, Fp2, FT7 and TP8 are reversed. One pass: amygdala signal, 4 s of silence, hippocampal signal, 4 s of silence. The amygdala signal is the project's rising sweep (6 to 30 Hz) with the published point duration and length (230 points of 3 ms; Ryczko 2002 p.1 [592]); its point values were never published as numbers. The hippocampal signal is the primed burst: one pulse, then four pulses 170 ms later, three times in 0.74 s (after Tsang 2004 p.5 [1017]). Both are rebuilt from descriptions: the vendor's files are not published. The vendor's 10 to 50 mG carries no distance (measurement.htm, duds.htm); an independent meter read 0.1 to 1.0 uT RMS about 9 cm from the coils (Gendle 2012 p.11 [227]). This program's setting is the peak field 20 mm in front of each coil. The effects are vendor claims. Independent sham-controlled tests of God-Helmet-type fields found no field effect (Granqvist 2005, double-blind; Gendle & McGrath 2012, where the experimenter knew the condition). The vendor: lower the intensity by one third if headache or pressure appears; too many Altered States or Feelgood sessions 'can create a kind of malaise or even lethargy'. Not for anyone with epilepsy, a psychiatric condition or medication, migraine or brain injury, or on drugs. Stop on fear or distress.
setting: For effects during the session: darkness and silence, eyes closed, relaxed without meditating or falling asleep. For meditation: end the session 1-2 h before you practise; never meditate or use other mind machines during it (vendor).
schedule: Vendor (Feelgood and Altered States page): no more often than every three days for the 40-min session (once a week when effects appear for the 60-min one), never on consecutive days; a series of up to 6 sessions, then a 3-week break. If no effects appear, alternate Altered States and Feelgood (murphy-shakti8-feelgood-2phase-40min) every three days for three sessions, then stop for a week (the vendor's general safety page, by contrast, advises against going back and forth between two session designs).
